addition.item: Add a manual version release workflow and native plugin update feed, using Git User once and OctoShoom for SHA-512 hashes.

change.item: Move the webservices plugin from the component into its own directly installable repository, included independently by OctoJPack.

fix.item: Register no MCP API routes when the component is absent or disabled.
Enable fresh plugin installations while preserving an administrator's disabled state on updates.

note.item: Release both independent plugins before the component's first package release; OctoJPack includes their latest tags.
